messages:
maria.ng: Quick check — export UX for Console audit logs: current behavior returns all fields including KMS-encrypted blobs. Is that allowed for customers? We might leak ciphertext or sensitive metadata.
jonathan.p: Hmm we shouldn't surface raw ciphertext. What fields are you seeing?
maria.ng: For some key rotation events and kms API calls we have `encrypted_blob` and `kms_key_id` in the event payload. CSV export serializes them. Elaine, any compliance constraints?
elaine.compliance: Customers can see their own events but we must avoid exposing internal KMS ARNs or wrapped ciphertext. Masking or redaction needed. Also some regions require showing key alias only, not full ARN.
samir.frontend: UX question — filters + pagination: users can filter by actor, resource, action, time range. For large exports (>100k rows) we stream and paginate. Should server-side redact or client-side?
maria.ng: Server-side. Client can't be trusted. Proposal: add `audit_export` permission that can download raw JSON; `audit_viewer` only gets masked CSV/JSON. Need RBAC change and migration plan.
jonathan.p: Agree. Also add an audit event schema field `event.metadata.encryption_redacted: true|false` so UI can show why something was masked. That will help support.
maria.ng: Example schema change (draft):
```json
{
 "event.type": "kms.encrypt",
 "event.actor": "service-account-12",
 "event.resource": "model-checkpoint-xyz",
 "event.metadata": {
   "encrypted_blob": "<redacted>",
   "kms_key_alias": "alias/redwood-prod",
   "encryption_redacted": "true"
 }
}
```
elaine.compliance: Also need an opt-in for customers to request raw exports for their KMS-owned blobs, but must go through support + signed DPA addendum.
jonathan.p: UX: in export modal show two checkboxes: "Include sensitive fields (requires audit_export role)" and "Mask PII by default". If user checks sensitive, do server-side RBAC check and create a background export job.
samir.frontend: For pagination tokens we use a cursor-based token like `export_cursor_v2:eyJ...` which expires in 24h. Background job will produce signed S3 URL and post a message to the Console notifications.
maria.ng: Edge cases: - schema migrations for older events (no `encryption_redacted`); - mixed datasets where some rows redacted and some not. We'll default missing flag to `true` for safety.
jonathan.p: Rate limiting: exports limited per org to 3 concurrent jobs. Implement queue with priority for enterprise tenants.
maria.ng: Tests: add unit tests for validation logic: verifying that `encrypted_blob` and `kms_.*_arn` patterns are rejected unless role present. Also e2e test for export file formats (CSV/JSON/GZIP).
elaine.compliance: Also ensure export audit event is itself logged with fields: actor, requester_role, filter_query, result_count, export_id.
audit-bot: Notice: RFC 2026-audit-export-redaction created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RFC-2026. Assigned to @maria.ng for implementation plan.
maria.ng: Action items: 1) RBAC change PR (maria) due Tue EOD. 2) Backend export job + signed URL (samir + jonathan) due next Fri. 3) Compliance review + DPA template (elaine) due next Tue. 4) QA tests (qa team) - add ticket.
jonathan.p: I'll make the export modal mock in Figma and post link here.
samir.frontend: Will prototype server streaming endpoint `/api/v1/audit-exports` with chunked gzipped newline-delimited JSON for large exports.
maria.ng: Thanks. If anyone finds any API shapes we missed, paste snippets here. I'll start the RBAC PR and add migration note for historical events.
jonathan.p: FYI — some customers asked for CSV column whitelist per-tenant. We'll support columns param in export API, but server validates allowed columns for the role.
elaine.compliance: Also log whether export included redacted fields (bool) in the admin audit trail.
maria.ng: Cool. Closing this thread; follow-ups in RFC and PRs. :thumbsup:
